outcome: A +X/+Y or -X/-Y counter changes the object's power and toughness by X and Y.
A keyword counter makes the object have that keyword.
A shield counter turns destruction by an effect or damage into the removal of a shield counter instead.
A stun counter replaces untapping with removal of a stun counter, leaving the permanent tapped.
A planeswalker with 0 loyalty counters is put into its owner's graveyard in the state-based check.
A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game in the state-based check.
A battle with 0 defense counters goes to its owner's graveyard unless it is the source of a triggered ability still awaiting the stack.
A permanent with a finality counter that would go to the graveyard from the battlefield is exiled instead.
A player with rad counters has a rad triggered ability fire at the start of their precombat main phase.
A creature with a hone-counter Equipment attached gets +1/+0.
Counters on an object cease to exist when it changes zones, so the object arrives in the new zone with none.
A permanent with both +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters has the smaller number of each removed in the state-based check.
A permanent with more counters of a kind than its can't-have-more-than-N limit loses the excess in the state-based check.
Moving a counter removes it from one object and puts it on another, and does nothing if either half is impossible.

note: counters put on an object include those it enters the battlefield with; sub-rule carries the outcome

outcome: An object entering with counters has them put on by the controller unless the effect names another player.
An Nth-counter trigger fires only when the count crosses from below N to N or more.
A leaves-the-battlefield trigger putting the leaver's counters on another object gives it the same number of each kind the leaver had.
An activated ability with a sacrifice cost putting the sacrificed object's counters elsewhere gives the other object the same number of each kind.
